Higher values mean stronger braking.
Recommended: 2.0 ~ 10.0
elytradrag.configuration.minimumSpeed.to: Drag stops applying below this speed, preventing jittering while hovering.
elytradrag.configuration.maxFallDistance:
Prevents massive fall damage when diving at high speeds.
Note: This option is controlled by the server in multiplayer.
elytradrag.configuration.removeKineticDa: When enabled, flying into a wall while braking won't instantly kill you.
elytradrag.configuration.keepDaBREnabled:
When enabled, braking only applies drag. DoABarrelRoll keeps running, so roll, yaw and the view stay untouched, and nothing keeps turning after releasing a key.
When disabled, braking temporarily suppresses DoABarrelRoll's rolling group and levels the view (older behaviour).
